title: Toward a Theoretical Understanding of Transformer Attention: Bayesian Estimation and Predictive Sufficiency
abstract: arXiv:2611.30349v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a theoretical account of Transformer attention by organizing existing probabilistic and information-theoretic results. It identifies the assumptions under which attention computes a posterior mean and the additional conditions required for accurate next-token prediction. Posterior-mean optimality under squared-error loss does not by itself establish predictive sufficiency; even a sufficient representation requires a prediction head that uses its information correctly. An excess-log-loss decomposition makes this distinction precise by separating representation information loss from prediction-head error. The analysis clarifies the conditions required for predictive guarantees. Determining when these conditions hold in trained models, and how architectural or training choices can support them, could guide the development of AI systems that preserve and use predictive information more effectively.

translated_title: 迈向Transformer注意力的理论理解：贝叶斯估计与预测充分性
translated_abstract: 本文通过整理现有的概率论与信息论结果，为Transformer注意力机制建立了理论阐释。论文识别了注意力在何种假设下计算后验均值，以及实现准确的下一词元预测所需的额外条件。平方误差损失下的后验均值最优性本身并不足以确立预测充分性；即使是充分表征，也需要一个能正确利用其信息的预测头。通过将超额对数损失分解为表征信息损失与预测头误差两部分，论文精确地阐明了这一区别。该分析明确了获得预测保证所需的条件。确定这些条件何时在训练好的模型中成立，以及架构或训练选择如何支持这些条件，可以指导开发更有效地保留和利用预测信息的AI系统。
tldr: 本文通过贝叶斯估计与信息论视角系统梳理了Transformer注意力的理论结果，明确注意力计算后验均值所需假设，并通过超额对数损失分解区分表征信息损失与预测头误差，从而阐明了实现下一词元预测保证的前提条件。
en_tdlr: This paper organizes probabilistic and information-theoretic results into a theoretical account of Transformer attention, identifying the assumptions under which attention computes a posterior mean and using an excess-log-loss decomposition to separate representation information loss from prediction-head error, thereby clarifying the conditions required for predictive guarantees.
